frozen_candidate_root_contribution: lqy encodes the JUNCTURE of two entities — one coming into direct contact/arrival with a counterpart — with the derivational form fixing the DIRECTION of that contact. Form I (laqiya) = a subject comes upon / into confrontation with an object (person, foe, God, or an incurred outcome); Forms VIII/VI = two parties mutually converge; Form III nominal/participle (liqāʾ, mulāqī, yulāqī) = the (chiefly eschatological) Encounter itself and the one who will meet; Form V (talaqqā) = accept/take up what reaches one; Form II (laqqā) = cause a person to receive an immaterial good. Form IV (alqā) is the productive causative of Form I — 'cause an object to reach/arrive at a target' → cast / throw / put down / place / project / deliver — bridged to the encounter core by its causative morphology, the pervasive ilā/fī/ʿalā-goal arrival frame, and transparent deliver-to-recipient tokens (alqā ilā X 'a word/book/peace'), even though its lexicalized center of gravity is 'cast/deliver', not 'meet'. This is one derivational family with morphologically distributed senses, not a single narrow gloss and not two unrelated homonyms.

internal_discovery.plain_explanation: The root ل ق ي is about two things being brought into direct contact. Depending on the verb pattern, that contact is described from a different angle: you 'meet/come upon' someone or something (Form I); two sides 'converge' on each other (Forms VIII/VI); the noun names 'the Meeting', above all the future meeting with God (Form III); you 'receive/take up' what comes to you (Form V) or are 'made to receive' a gift like revelation or reward (Form II); and — as the causative — you 'cast, throw, put down, or deliver' an object so it reaches a place or a recipient (Form IV). The forms carry the grammar of who reaches whom; the shared idea is arrival-into-contact.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: lqy does NOT entail: (1) valence — it covers meeting believers deceptively (2:14:2:1), enemies in war (8:15:5:1), a doomed boy (18:74), God (33:44:3:1), or fatigue/error/sin/death (18:62:8:1, 19:59:10:1, 25:68:21:1, 3:143:8:1) indifferently; positivity/negativity is supplied only by an explicit object (25:75:6:2 greeting vs a Hell-terminus). (2) volition or seeking — one 'meets' fatigue, perdition, death unbidden and 'finds' the book already spread (17:13:12:1); it is contact, never search. (3) speech — alqā can DELIVER a word, but the word is a separate cast object; lqy is transfer/contact, not saying. (4) violence in Form IV — it equally sets mountains (16:15:1:2), casts love (20:39:16:2), delivers revelation (73:5), tenders peace (4:90:28:2). (5) material giving in Form II — laqqā imparts only immaterial goods (Qurʾan, reward, joy, greeting), never property. (6) mere motion/arrival at a place — unlike jāʾa/atā it requires a counterpart brought into contact, the frozen tilqāʾ 'toward/of one's own accord' being the lexicalized exception, not the live verb.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 84:4:1:2 — wa-alqat mā fīhā wa-takhallat ('[the earth] cast out what is in it and emptied itself'): Form IV here is expulsion/ejection with the terminus OUT/AWAY and no counterpart or recipient, inverting rather than instantiating the two-entities-converge nucleus; it is absorbed only by the CAST class's 'directed projection including ejection', not by the encounter core, and it is reinforced by the Quran-internal interchange of alqā with qadhafa 'to hurl' in the same act (20:39, 20:87). This is the single occurrence that most strongly prevents collapsing the whole root into one 'meeting' gloss.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: Two unbridged classes / homonymy: an ENCOUNTER field (I, III, VI, VIII, with II/V receive as a soft satellite) versus an autonomous CAST/THROW/DELIVER field (Form IV, ~51% of the data), treated as only etymologically related. It is credible because Form IV is the plurality class, is not synchronically read as 'cause to meet', forms a self-sufficient semantic field, and its pure-throw/ejection wing (7:107:1:2, 12:10, 84:4:1:2) is never touched by any encounter sense; the abstraction needed to span both poles ('cause to arrive at a terminus') risks being non-distinctive (indistinguishable from qadhafa/jaʿala/waḍaʿa). It is NOT adopted because the causative morphology plus the shared ilā/fī/ʿalā-goal frame and transparently deliver-to-recipient tokens (4:171:21:1 alqāhā ilā Maryam; 27:29:5:1 ulqiya ilayya kitāb; 4:90:28:2 alqaw ilaykum al-salam) constitute a demonstrable Quran-internal bridge from Form IV into the RECEIVE (27:6:2:2 tulaqqā al-qurʾān) and thence ENCOUNTER core — but this bridge is a recipient-directed minority of IV, which is exactly why the account is capped at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE rather than STRONG/UNIVERSAL.

internal_discovery.rationale: All three analysts read full coverage (146/146). Two independent lenses (A, B) converge on a single form-conditioned nucleus graded MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE; the adversary (C) presses a two-pole homonymy reading yet still concedes a narrower encounter claim at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE and locates the disagreement entirely in whether Form IV is bridged. The decisive question is bridge-existence. A bridge IS Quran-internally demonstrated: Form IV is the productive causative of Form I, and its deliver-to-recipient tokens (4:171:21:1, 27:29:5:1, 4:90:28:2, 28:86:5:1) share the arrival-at-a-recipient structure that RECEIVE (27:6:2:2) and ENCOUNTER instantiate. Because a genuine bridge exists, the contract's UNRESOLVED-on-no-bridge rule does not fire; the honest frame is DERIVATIONAL_FAMILY, not homonymy. But two caps apply and forbid STRONG/UNIVERSAL: (a) a coherent resistant LEXICALIZED sub-class exists — the frozen tilqāʾ directional/idiom (7:47:4:1, 28:22:3:1, 10:15:24:1), including the fully bleached min tilqāʾi nafsī; and (b) material resistance within Form IV — the ejection paradigm 84:4:1:2 and the pure-throw wing — whose dominant reading is 'cast/deliver', not 'meet', and which the unifying abstraction spans only thinly. Per 'prefer the narrowest supported account', 'do not over-grade', and 'a resistant lexicalized/nominal sub-class or material resistance caps strength at MODERATE and scope at REPRESENTATIVE', the aggregate judgment is PREFERRED / MODERATE / REPRESENTATIVE / DERIVATIONAL_FAMILY.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Form I laqiya/laqū: the subject comes upon / into direct contact or confrontation with a counterpart — person, foe, God, or an incurred outcome — valence and volition supplied only by context.
clusters.classification_rationale: 14 finite Form I tokens all instantiate 'arrival into direct contact with an object', spanning deceptive social meeting (2:14:2:1), battle (8:15:5:1), an incidental person (18:74), the eschatological meeting of God (33:44:3:1), and involuntary experiential objects (fatigue 18:62:8:1, perdition 19:59:10:1, penalty 25:68:21:1, death 3:143:8:1). The consistent nucleus is contact, never seeking; the book is 'found already spread' (17:13:12:1).
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: Adversarially clean across friendly, hostile, divine, and abstract objects; no counterexample within Form I resists 'come into contact with'.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Reciprocal convergence: two entities (dual/plural subject) come together on each other — hosts colliding in battle, seas/waters meeting — plus the nominal yawm al-talāq 'the Day of the (mutual) Meeting'.
clusters.classification_rationale: Form VIII iltaqā and Form VI talāq carry the reciprocal/reflexive voice cleanly: 8:41:27:1, 3:13:7:1, 8:44:4:1 (two hosts), 54:12:4:2 / 55:19:3:1 (waters/seas), 40:15:16:2 (the Meeting-Day nominal). Subject is inherently two-party; no agent-patient asymmetry.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: The non-animate convergence of seas (55:19:3:1) shows the core is spatial/entity convergence, not specifically social — a distinctive, morphology-carried nuance.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: The Encounter itself and the one-who-will-meet: verbal noun liqāʾ (chiefly the eschatological Encounter with God / one's Day, as a creedal object of belief or denial), active participle mulāqī/lāqī 'one who will meet', and finite yulāqī 'meet their Day'.
clusters.classification_rationale: 35 tokens: liqāʾ Allah / rabbihim / al-ākhira / yawmikum governed by belief-verbs (10:7:5:1, 6:31:5:2, 32:14, 7:51), participles mulāqū rabbihim (2:46:4:1, 11:29:17:1, 2:249:47:1) and the reciprocal mulāqīkum where death 'will meet YOU' (62:8:8:1), and finite yulāqū yawmahum (43:83, 52:45, 70:42). 2:46:4:1 distinguishes lqy (the face-to-face encounter) from rujūʿ (the return), pinning it to the encounter event.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: The most distinctive, adversarially clean pattern in the root: the eschatological liqāʾ-as-creedal-object. 62:8:8:1 disproves any assumption the human is always the agent, confirming genuine reciprocity.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Causative of Form I: an agent causes an object to reach/arrive at a target → cast, throw, put down, place, project, deliver (and, at the boundary, eject/disgorge). Target typically marked by fī / ʿalā / ilā + goal or recipient.
clusters.classification_rationale: 75 tokens with a pervasive arrival-frame: ballistic throw (7:107:1:2, alqā ʿaṣāhu), cast-into (12:10 well, 37:97 fire, 28:7 sea), emplacement (16:15:1:2 mountains), abstracta into hearts (3:151:1:2 terror, 5:64:27:2 enmity, 20:39:16:2 love), and — the bridge into the encounter core — deliver-to-recipient (4:171:21:1 the word to Mary, 27:29:5:1 a letter, 4:90:28:2 tendering peace, 28:86:5:1 / 40:15:5:1 book/spirit). One boundary token, 84:4:1:2 (the earth 'casts out what is in it and empties itself'), is expulsion/ejection with the terminus out/away, absorbed by 'directed projection including ejection' but resisting the two-entities-converge nucleus; it is reinforced by the alqā~qadhafa interchange (20:39, 20:87).
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: The dominant surface reading is 'cast/deliver', not 'meet'; it is retained as one derivational family — the causative of Form I — via morphology, the ilā/fī/ʿalā-goal frame, and transparent deliver-to-recipient tokens, while its thinness of bridge and its ejection/pure-throw wing are exactly what cap the root claim at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: laqqā/yulaqqā: cause a person to RECEIVE an immaterial good — revelation, reward, radiance/joy, greeting — double-transitive, with a distinctive restriction to non-material objects.
clusters.classification_rationale: 6 tokens: tulaqqā al-qurʾan (27:6:2:2), laqqāhum naḍratan wa-surūran (76:11:6:2), yulaqqawna taḥiyyatan (25:75:6:2), the reward-word granted only to the steadfast (28:80:14:1, 41:35:2:1, 41:35:7:1). The object is always immaterial — never property — separating it cleanly from ātā/wahaba 'give'.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: Distinctive object-restriction (immaterial goods only) is a first-class boundary result; strong within its form but narrow in scope.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: talaqqā: the receptive/reflexive end of the transfer — accept, take up, welcome, record what reaches one.
clusters.classification_rationale: 5 tokens: Adam received words (2:37:1:2), you took up/relayed the slander (24:15:2:1), angels receive/welcome them (21:103:5:2), and the two recording angels 'receive' (50:17:2:1 verb + 50:17:3:2 agent-noun al-mutalaqqiyān). Consistent 'accepting/taking up what arrives'.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: Soft satellite of the encounter pole ('let something come to meet oneself'); 24:15:2:1 drifts toward 'take up and circulate' but remains within receptive uptake.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: tilqāʾ: a frozen directional/ablative nominal 'the side/direction faced' → 'toward', and, fully bleached, 'of one's own accord'. The live meeting/casting event is lexicalized out.
clusters.classification_rationale: 3 tokens: tilqāʾa madyan 'toward Madyan' (28:22:3:1), tilqāʾa aṣḥāb al-nār 'in the direction of the Fire-dwellers' (7:47:4:1), and min tilqāʾi nafsī 'of my own accord' (10:15:24:1) where the sense is fully idiomatic. This is a coherent resistant LEXICALIZED sub-class, not predicted by either the encounter or the cast reading.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: Per the contract, a coherent resistant lexicalized/nominal sub-class caps the root claim at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE; all three tokens are final-RESISTANT and recorded as hard cases and counterevidence.

reconciliation.rationale: The root claim is a DERIVATIONAL_FAMILY, not a single convergence gloss. Within the Form IV causative-projection class ('cause an object to reach a terminus, including outward'), 84:4:1:2 is the boundary/ejection case, consistent with that class while remaining the strongest counterexample to over-unification. Retained as an ADVERSARIAL_BOUNDARY hard case and in counterevidence.

In min tilqāʾi nafsī the meaning is fully idiomatic ('of my own accord'), with both the encounter and the directional-facing sense bleached out; it is the clearest member of the resistant lexicalized tilqāʾ class and is graded final-RESISTANT.
Form III's participle is reciprocal by morphology; direction of the encounter is not fixed to the human, so mulāqīkum instantiates the convergence nucleus rather than resisting it.

adversarial_verification.notes: A formal adversarial refutation returning SUPPORTED with failing_occurrences=[] cannot be claimed: a coherent resistant lexicalized sub-class (tilqāʾ) and material Form IV resistance (ejection 84:4:1:2) persist, and the whole-root abstraction spanning ENCOUNTER and CAST is not fully distinctive. The core derivational-family account nonetheless holds via the causative bridge, so the correct status is NOT_RUN with the resisting occurrences recorded, not PASSED and not FAILED.

occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Causative of Form I: an agent causes an object to reach/arrive at a target → cast, throw, put down, place, project, deliver (and, at the boundary, eject/disgorge). Target typically marked by fī / ʿalā / ilā + goal or recipient.
occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: The dominant surface reading is 'cast/deliver', not 'meet'; it is retained as one derivational family — the causative of Form I — via morphology, the ilā/fī/ʿalā-goal frame, and transparent deliver-to-recipient tokens, while its thinness of bridge and its ejection/pure-throw wing are exactly what cap the root claim at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE.

occurrence_dispositions.note: 35 tokens: liqāʾ Allah / rabbihim / al-ākhira / yawmikum governed by belief-verbs (10:7:5:1, 6:31:5:2, 32:14, 7:51), participles mulāqū rabbihim (2:46:4:1, 11:29:17:1, 2:249:47:1) and the reciprocal mulāqīkum where death 'will meet YOU' (62:8:8:1), and finite yulāqū yawmahum (43:83, 52:45, 70:42). 2:46:4:1 distinguishes lqy (the face-to-face encounter) from rujūʿ (the return), pinning it to the encounter event.
occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: The Encounter itself and the one-who-will-meet: verbal noun liqāʾ (chiefly the eschatological Encounter with God / one's Day, as a creedal object of belief or denial), active participle mulāqī/lāqī 'one who will meet', and finite yulāqī 'meet their Day'.
occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: The most distinctive, adversarially clean pattern in the root: the eschatological liqāʾ-as-creedal-object. 62:8:8:1 disproves any assumption the human is always the agent, confirming genuine reciprocity.

One boundary token, 84:4:1:2 (the earth 'casts out what is in it and empties itself'), is expulsion/ejection with the terminus out/away, absorbed by 'directed projection including ejection' but resisting the two-entities-converge nucleus; it is reinforced by the alqā~qadhafa interchange (20:39, 20:87).
occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Causative of Form I: an agent causes an object to reach/arrive at a target → cast, throw, put down, place, project, deliver (and, at the boundary, eject/disgorge). Target typically marked by fī / ʿalā / ilā + goal or recipient.
occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: The dominant surface reading is 'cast/deliver', not 'meet'; it is retained as one derivational family — the causative of Form I — via morphology, the ilā/fī/ʿalā-goal frame, and transparent deliver-to-recipient tokens, while its thinness of bridge and its ejection/pure-throw wing are exactly what cap the root claim at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE.

occurrence_dispositions.note: 35 tokens: liqāʾ Allah / rabbihim / al-ākhira / yawmikum governed by belief-verbs (10:7:5:1, 6:31:5:2, 32:14, 7:51), participles mulāqū rabbihim (2:46:4:1, 11:29:17:1, 2:249:47:1) and the reciprocal mulāqīkum where death 'will meet YOU' (62:8:8:1), and finite yulāqū yawmahum (43:83, 52:45, 70:42). 2:46:4:1 distinguishes lqy (the face-to-face encounter) from rujūʿ (the return), pinning it to the encounter event.
occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: The Encounter itself and the one-who-will-meet: verbal noun liqāʾ (chiefly the eschatological Encounter with God / one's Day, as a creedal object of belief or denial), active participle mulāqī/lāqī 'one who will meet', and finite yulāqī 'meet their Day'.
occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: The most distinctive, adversarially clean pattern in the root: the eschatological liqāʾ-as-creedal-object. 62:8:8:1 disproves any assumption the human is always the agent, confirming genuine reciprocity.

occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: The Encounter itself and the one-who-will-meet: verbal noun liqāʾ (chiefly the eschatological Encounter with God / one's Day, as a creedal object of belief or denial), active participle mulāqī/lāqī 'one who will meet', and finite yulāqī 'meet their Day'.
occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: The most distinctive, adversarially clean pattern in the root: the eschatological liqāʾ-as-creedal-object. 62:8:8:1 disproves any assumption the human is always the agent, confirming genuine reciprocity.

occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: Adversarially clean across friendly, hostile, divine, and abstract objects; no counterexample within Form I resists 'come into contact with'.

One boundary token, 84:4:1:2 (the earth 'casts out what is in it and empties itself'), is expulsion/ejection with the terminus out/away, absorbed by 'directed projection including ejection' but resisting the two-entities-converge nucleus; it is reinforced by the alqā~qadhafa interchange (20:39, 20:87).

One boundary token, 84:4:1:2 (the earth 'casts out what is in it and empties itself'), is expulsion/ejection with the terminus out/away, absorbed by 'directed projection including ejection' but resisting the two-entities-converge nucleus; it is reinforced by the alqā~qadhafa interchange (20:39, 20:87).
occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Causative of Form I: an agent causes an object to reach/arrive at a target → cast, throw, put down, place, project, deliver (and, at the boundary, eject/disgorge). Target typically marked by fī / ʿalā / ilā + goal or recipient.
occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: The dominant surface reading is 'cast/deliver', not 'meet'; it is retained as one derivational family — the causative of Form I — via morphology, the ilā/fī/ʿalā-goal frame, and transparent deliver-to-recipient tokens, while its thinness of bridge and its ejection/pure-throw wing are exactly what cap the root claim at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE.

occurrence_dispositions.note: 35 tokens: liqāʾ Allah / rabbihim / al-ākhira / yawmikum governed by belief-verbs (10:7:5:1, 6:31:5:2, 32:14, 7:51), participles mulāqū rabbihim (2:46:4:1, 11:29:17:1, 2:249:47:1) and the reciprocal mulāqīkum where death 'will meet YOU' (62:8:8:1), and finite yulāqū yawmahum (43:83, 52:45, 70:42). 2:46:4:1 distinguishes lqy (the face-to-face encounter) from rujūʿ (the return), pinning it to the encounter event.
occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: The Encounter itself and the one-who-will-meet: verbal noun liqāʾ (chiefly the eschatological Encounter with God / one's Day, as a creedal object of belief or denial), active participle mulāqī/lāqī 'one who will meet', and finite yulāqī 'meet their Day'.
occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: The most distinctive, adversarially clean pattern in the root: the eschatological liqāʾ-as-creedal-object. 62:8:8:1 disproves any assumption the human is always the agent, confirming genuine reciprocity.

occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Form I laqiya/laqū: the subject comes upon / into direct contact or confrontation with a counterpart — person, foe, God, or an incurred outcome — valence and volition supplied only by context.
occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: Adversarially clean across friendly, hostile, divine, and abstract objects; no counterexample within Form I resists 'come into contact with'.

occurrence_dispositions.note: 75 tokens with a pervasive arrival-frame: ballistic throw (7:107:1:2, alqā ʿaṣāhu), cast-into (12:10 well, 37:97 fire, 28:7 sea), emplacement (16:15:1:2 mountains), abstracta into hearts (3:151:1:2 terror, 5:64:27:2 enmity, 20:39:16:2 love), and — the bridge into the encounter core — deliver-to-recipient (4:171:21:1 the word to Mary, 27:29:5:1 a letter, 4:90:28:2 tendering peace, 28:86:5:1 / 40:15:5:1 book/spirit). One boundary token, 84:4:1:2 (the earth 'casts out what is in it and empties itself'), is expulsion/ejection with the terminus out/away, absorbed by 'directed projection including ejection' but resisting the two-entities-converge nucleus; it is reinforced by the alqā~qadhafa interchange (20:39, 20:87).
occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Causative of Form I: an agent causes an object to reach/arrive at a target → cast, throw, put down, place, project, deliver (and, at the boundary, eject/disgorge). Target typically marked by fī / ʿalā / ilā + goal or recipient.
occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: The dominant surface reading is 'cast/deliver', not 'meet'; it is retained as one derivational family — the causative of Form I — via morphology, the ilā/fī/ʿalā-goal frame, and transparent deliver-to-recipient tokens, while its thinness of bridge and its ejection/pure-throw wing are exactly what cap the root claim at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE.

occurrence_dispositions.note: 75 tokens with a pervasive arrival-frame: ballistic throw (7:107:1:2, alqā ʿaṣāhu), cast-into (12:10 well, 37:97 fire, 28:7 sea), emplacement (16:15:1:2 mountains), abstracta into hearts (3:151:1:2 terror, 5:64:27:2 enmity, 20:39:16:2 love), and — the bridge into the encounter core — deliver-to-recipient (4:171:21:1 the word to Mary, 27:29:5:1 a letter, 4:90:28:2 tendering peace, 28:86:5:1 / 40:15:5:1 book/spirit). One boundary token, 84:4:1:2 (the earth 'casts out what is in it and empties itself'), is expulsion/ejection with the terminus out/away, absorbed by 'directed projection including ejection' but resisting the two-entities-converge nucleus; it is reinforced by the alqā~qadhafa interchange (20:39, 20:87).
occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Causative of Form I: an agent causes an object to reach/arrive at a target → cast, throw, put down, place, project, deliver (and, at the boundary, eject/disgorge). Target typically marked by fī / ʿalā / ilā + goal or recipient.
occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: The dominant surface reading is 'cast/deliver', not 'meet'; it is retained as one derivational family — the causative of Form I — via morphology, the ilā/fī/ʿalā-goal frame, and transparent deliver-to-recipient tokens, while its thinness of bridge and its ejection/pure-throw wing are exactly what cap the root claim at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE.

occurrence_dispositions.note: 35 tokens: liqāʾ Allah / rabbihim / al-ākhira / yawmikum governed by belief-verbs (10:7:5:1, 6:31:5:2, 32:14, 7:51), participles mulāqū rabbihim (2:46:4:1, 11:29:17:1, 2:249:47:1) and the reciprocal mulāqīkum where death 'will meet YOU' (62:8:8:1), and finite yulāqū yawmahum (43:83, 52:45, 70:42). 2:46:4:1 distinguishes lqy (the face-to-face encounter) from rujūʿ (the return), pinning it to the encounter event.
occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: The Encounter itself and the one-who-will-meet: verbal noun liqāʾ (chiefly the eschatological Encounter with God / one's Day, as a creedal object of belief or denial), active participle mulāqī/lāqī 'one who will meet', and finite yulāqī 'meet their Day'.
occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: The most distinctive, adversarially clean pattern in the root: the eschatological liqāʾ-as-creedal-object. 62:8:8:1 disproves any assumption the human is always the agent, confirming genuine reciprocity.

occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: The Encounter itself and the one-who-will-meet: verbal noun liqāʾ (chiefly the eschatological Encounter with God / one's Day, as a creedal object of belief or denial), active participle mulāqī/lāqī 'one who will meet', and finite yulāqī 'meet their Day'.
occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: The most distinctive, adversarially clean pattern in the root: the eschatological liqāʾ-as-creedal-object. 62:8:8:1 disproves any assumption the human is always the agent, confirming genuine reciprocity.
occurrence_dispositions.preliminary_note: mulāqīkum — death is the one that 'meets' the human, an apparent reversal of the expected agent.
occurrence_dispositions.reconciliation_rationale: Form III's participle is reciprocal by morphology; direction of the encounter is not fixed to the human, so mulāqīkum instantiates the convergence nucleus rather than resisting it.

occurrence_dispositions.note: 75 tokens with a pervasive arrival-frame: ballistic throw (7:107:1:2, alqā ʿaṣāhu), cast-into (12:10 well, 37:97 fire, 28:7 sea), emplacement (16:15:1:2 mountains), abstracta into hearts (3:151:1:2 terror, 5:64:27:2 enmity, 20:39:16:2 love), and — the bridge into the encounter core — deliver-to-recipient (4:171:21:1 the word to Mary, 27:29:5:1 a letter, 4:90:28:2 tendering peace, 28:86:5:1 / 40:15:5:1 book/spirit). One boundary token, 84:4:1:2 (the earth 'casts out what is in it and empties itself'), is expulsion/ejection with the terminus out/away, absorbed by 'directed projection including ejection' but resisting the two-entities-converge nucleus; it is reinforced by the alqā~qadhafa interchange (20:39, 20:87).
occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Causative of Form I: an agent causes an object to reach/arrive at a target → cast, throw, put down, place, project, deliver (and, at the boundary, eject/disgorge). Target typically marked by fī / ʿalā / ilā + goal or recipient.
occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: The dominant surface reading is 'cast/deliver', not 'meet'; it is retained as one derivational family — the causative of Form I — via morphology, the ilā/fī/ʿalā-goal frame, and transparent deliver-to-recipient tokens, while its thinness of bridge and its ejection/pure-throw wing are exactly what cap the root claim at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE.

occurrence_dispositions.note: Absorbed by the Form IV causative-projection class as its boundary (ejection) case; retained as the strongest counterexample against forcing a single encounter nucleus, and as an ADVERSARIAL_BOUNDARY hard case. | 84:4:1:2 — wa-alqat mā fīhā wa-takhallat ('[the earth] cast out what is in it and emptied itself'): Form IV here is expulsion/ejection with the terminus OUT/AWAY and no counterpart or recipient, inverting rather than instantiating the two-entities-converge nucleus; it is absorbed only by the CAST class's 'directed projection including ejection', not by the encounter core, and it is reinforced by the Quran-internal interchange of alqā with qadhafa 'to hurl' in the same act (20:39, 20:87).
occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Causative of Form I: an agent causes an object to reach/arrive at a target → cast, throw, put down, place, project, deliver (and, at the boundary, eject/disgorge). Target typically marked by fī / ʿalā / ilā + goal or recipient.
occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: The dominant surface reading is 'cast/deliver', not 'meet'; it is retained as one derivational family — the causative of Form I — via morphology, the ilā/fī/ʿalā-goal frame, and transparent deliver-to-recipient tokens, while its thinness of bridge and its ejection/pure-throw wing are exactly what cap the root claim at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE.
occurrence_dispositions.preliminary_note: The earth 'casts out what is in it and empties itself' (wa-alqat mā fīhā wa-takhallat): ejection with the terminus out/away and no counterpart, inverting the convergence nucleus.
occurrence_dispositions.reconciliation_rationale: The root claim is a DERIVATIONAL_FAMILY, not a single convergence gloss. Within the Form IV causative-projection class ('cause an object to reach a terminus, including outward'), 84:4:1:2 is the boundary/ejection case, consistent with that class while remaining the strongest counterexample to over-unification. Retained as an ADVERSARIAL_BOUNDARY hard case and in counterevidence.

independent_verification: Three independent lenses (A, B, C) all read full coverage; A and B converged on MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE, and adversary C's homonymy challenge was weighed and localized to the recorded resistant occurrences rather than refuting the bridged family.
candidate_root_contribution: lqy encodes the JUNCTURE of two entities — one coming into direct contact/arrival with a counterpart — with the derivational form fixing the DIRECTION of that contact. Form I (laqiya) = a subject comes upon / into confrontation with an object (person, foe, God, or an incurred outcome); Forms VIII/VI = two parties mutually converge; Form III nominal/participle (liqāʾ, mulāqī, yulāqī) = the (chiefly eschatological) Encounter itself and the one who will meet; Form V (talaqqā) = accept/take up what reaches one; Form II (laqqā) = cause a person to receive an immaterial good. Form IV (alqā) is the productive causative of Form I — 'cause an object to reach/arrive at a target' → cast / throw / put down / place / project / deliver — bridged to the encounter core by its causative morphology, the pervasive ilā/fī/ʿalā-goal arrival frame, and transparent deliver-to-recipient tokens (alqā ilā X 'a word/book/peace'), even though its lexicalized center of gravity is 'cast/deliver', not 'meet'. This is one derivational family with morphologically distributed senses, not a single narrow gloss and not two unrelated homonyms.

layer_attribution.derivation: Morphology fixes the direction of contact: Form I base contact; VIII/VI reciprocal convergence; III nominal/participial encounter; V reflexive receipt; II causative-of-receipt (immaterial objects); IV causative-of-contact (cast/deliver/place), the productive causative of Form I carrying the ilā/fī/ʿalā-goal arrival frame.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: One resistant lexicalized nominal class — frozen tilqāʾ (LOC + N: 7:47:4:1, 28:22:3:1, 10:15:24:1) — with min tilqāʾi nafsī fully bleached to an idiom of spontaneous origin; caps the root claim at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Valence (friendly/hostile), volition, and the specific referent of the Encounter (e.g. God, the Day, revelation) are supplied by verse context and narrative, NOT by the root; the root contributes only arrival-into-contact. Contextual eschatological reference must not be promoted into the root claim.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: Preliminary RESISTANT reading of 84:4:1:2 reconciled to CONSISTENT-within-CAST (boundary ejection case); 62:8:8:1 reconciled from apparent agent-reversal to genuine reciprocity; the tilqāʾ tokens confirmed final-RESISTANT; adversary C's two-class challenge weighed and localized rather than adopted, because the causative deliver-to-recipient bridge is Quran-internally demonstrated.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: Persisting resistance is confined to the lexicalized tilqāʾ class (10:15:24:1, 7:47:4:1, 28:22:3:1) and the Form IV ejection/pure-throw boundary (paradigm 84:4:1:2); these do not overturn the bridged derivational-family account but justify MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE and the NOT_RUN falsification status.

hard_cases.reason: Form IV expulsion/ejection with the terminus out/away and no counterpart, the strongest occurrence against a single-encounter nucleus; absorbed by the CAST class's directed-projection reading but marking its outer boundary.

evidence_basis.statement: 84:4:1:2 — wa-alqat mā fīhā wa-takhallat ('[the earth] cast out what is in it and emptied itself'): Form IV here is expulsion/ejection with the terminus OUT/AWAY and no counterpart or recipient, inverting rather than instantiating the two-entities-converge nucleus; it is absorbed only by the CAST class's 'directed projection including ejection', not by the encounter core, and it is reinforced by the Quran-internal interchange of alqā with qadhafa 'to hurl' in the same act (20:39, 20:87).

hard_case_representation.rationale: The judgment is PREFERRED with a demonstrated Quran-internal bridge, not unresolved; resistance is real but localized to an evidence-identified lexicalized tilqāʾ sub-class (final-RESISTANT) plus one Form IV ejection boundary (adversarial boundary absorbed by the CAST class). Each hard case's evidence_basis statement also appears verbatim as the strongest_counterexample or in the relevant cluster/override note.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A demonstration that Form IV (alqā) shares NO Quran-internal bridge with the encounter forms — i.e. that its deliver-to-recipient tokens are not the causative counterpart of Form I 'reach/meet' but a distinct homonymous field — such that the family must be partitioned into two unbridged senses rather than treated as one derivational family.
rejection_condition.search_location: The Form IV deliver-to-recipient sub-set (4:171:21:1, 27:29:5:1, 4:90:28:2, 28:86:5:1, 40:15:5:1) tested against the RECEIVE forms (27:6:2:2, 2:37:1:2) and against the pure-throw/ejection wing (7:107:1:2, 12:10:7:2, 84:4:1:2).
rejection_condition.verification_method: Check whether alqā ilā/ʿalā X ('cause Y to reach recipient X') and talaqqā/tulaqqā ('receive/be made to receive Y') describe the same transfer event from opposite ends within a shared verse-context; if they do (e.g. a thing cast ilā a recipient who is elsewhere said to talaqqā it), the causative bridge holds; if the two never meet and the abstraction spanning them collapses into a non-distinctive 'cause-to-arrive' indistinguishable from qadhafa/jaʿala, the bridge fails.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Exclude the frozen tilqāʾ tokens (already RESISTANT) and the ejection boundary (84:4:1:2) from the bridge test so they neither prop up nor sink the causative claim; require the bridge to rest on live recipient-directed alqā, not on the abstract umbrella.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If the bridge fails, downgrade to research_state=UNRESOLVED, result_strength=UNRESOLVED, claim_scope=LOCAL, claim_scope_kind=UNRESOLVED_CLASS_ONLY, splitting ENCOUNTER (I/III/VI/VIII + II/V) from an autonomous CAST field (IV) with tilqāʾ as a third lexicalized offshoot.

reopen_conditions: If a future reading shows any pure-throw or ejection Form IV token (e.g. 84:4:1:2, 7:107:1:2, 12:10:7:2) carrying a genuine 'meeting/convergence' residue, re-test whether CAST should merge fully into the encounter core (upgrade toward STRONG) rather than remain a bridged-but-distinct causative class.

If the tilqāʾ tokens (10:15:24:1, 7:47:4:1, 28:22:3:1) are shown to retain a live, productive 'facing/meeting' sense rather than a frozen directional/idiomatic one, the lexicalized-class cap is removed and scope may widen beyond REPRESENTATIVE.

If the alqā-ilā deliver-to-recipient set (4:171:21:1, 27:29:5:1, 4:90:28:2) is shown NOT to pair with the talaqqā/tulaqqā receive forms (27:6:2:2, 2:37:1:2) as one transfer event, the causative bridge fails and the root must be re-opened as UNRESOLVED / two-class partition.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: A formal adversarial refutation returning SUPPORTED with failing_occurrences=[] cannot be claimed: a coherent resistant lexicalized sub-class (tilqāʾ) and material Form IV resistance (ejection 84:4:1:2) persist, and the whole-root abstraction spanning ENCOUNTER and CAST is not fully distinctive. The core derivational-family account nonetheless holds via the causative bridge, so the correct status is NOT_RUN with the resisting occurrences recorded, not PASSED and not FAILED.
